entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-08-30
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • ILVerify does not detect disallowed boxing of byref-like types #132954
  • .NET 11 preview: ThreadPool work item that enqueues another work item and keeps running is 2x slower than .NET 10 #132952
  • .NET 10 has ~1.8x higher RPS than .NET 11 preview 7 on a minimal ASP.NET Core app #132951
  • ConnectWithRevocation_WithCallback fails with RevocationStatusUnknown #132950
  • [ci-scan-feedback] harden fixer self-dedup with a non-integrity-gated branch-list backstop #132949
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: COM Dynamic finalizer double-unadvises connection point #132947
  • GZipStream does not rewind a trailing 0x1F leftover on seekable leaveOpen streams #132946
  • .NET 11 preview: Tier 0 code for async method chains runs about 2x slower than on .NET 10 #132943
  • [ci-scan] Build break: Mono MiniFullAOT compile of JIT.Generics fails with MSB3077 (Recursive type definition detected) #132942
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: profiler runtimeasyncapis test returns exit code 100 in crossgen2 R2R (PROFILER TEST FAILED) #132941
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: TypeMap interop test FileNotFoundException in crossgen2 R2R (Validate_BlobOnlyAttributeTypeNames) #132940
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: Interop/COM/ComWrappers/GcRestrictedCalloutReversePInvoke times out waiting for concurrent Gen2 GC (linu [Content truncated due to length] #132939
  • Mono LLVM-AOT: `abcremoval.c` crashes on valid IL that reads a maybe-unassigned local through a bounds check #132936
